entries.what: Thao gets home from her night shift on 4 West, rides the nurse shuttle down Ortega Hill, and finds an email confirming the paid 8-hour charting class for Sept 9.
entries.outcome: Class date saved to her calendar.

entries.what: Sleeps 8:30 to 3 with the blackout curtains and box fan, while Vinca traffic backs up outside for the first day of school.
entries.outcome: Got about six and a half hours.

entries.what: Makes cà phê sữa đá in the thermos and walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop before heading to her night shift.
entries.outcome: Arrives at the gravel lot early and takes the shuttle up the hill.

entries.what: Works the night shift on 4 West with Jasmine and Rubén, with a quiet census, and eats leftover rice at 2 a.m.
entries.outcome: No incidents.

entries.what: After sleeping, Thao goes to Ruiz Family Market on Tuesday afternoon for fish sauce and produce.
entries.outcome: Stocks up before the heat wave.

entries.what: Skips Hạnh's 1 p.m. call mid-sleep and finds another Vietnamese voicemail later.
entries.outcome: Voicemail left unheard until evening.

entries.what: The heat wave starts. Thao comes home from nights to a hot unit 207 with no AC and picks up a portable unit from Hạnh's house on Pell Road.
entries.outcome: Portable unit set up in the bedroom for Aug 27-30.

entries.what: Works another night with heat cases coming through the ER and sends a couple of patients up to 4 West.
entries.outcome: Busy but handled.

entries.what: Sleeps badly through the heat despite the portable unit and the box fan.
entries.outcome: Only about five hours.

entries.what: Thao submits a maintenance request to Gloria Ibarra at Marisol Gardens about the leaking bathroom faucet in 207.
entries.outcome: Request logged as open; Gloria is slow to repair.

entries.what: Hears Theo crying through the 207/209 wall in the evening and puts in earplugs and white noise before her shift.
entries.outcome: Gets a short rest.

entries.what: Post-shift in the heat, Thao asks the assistant for a list of heat-safe cold meals to drop off at Hạnh's nail salon in Plaza Marisol.
entries.outcome: Picks cold rice-paper rolls and noodle salads from the list.

entries.what: Drops the cold meals at Lotus Nails and hears Hạnh complain about the heat and Linh's café job.
entries.outcome: Hạnh accepts the food, grumbling.

entries.what: Naps in the afternoon and waters the pothos and struggling basil on the balcony.
entries.outcome: Basil looks worse in the heat.

entries.what: Works Saturday night on 4 West in the last day of the heat wave, and the unit is full of heat cases.
entries.outcome: Maribel manages a tight ratio and Thao helps cover it.

entries.what: Goes to Phở Bến Thành with Jasmine after shift for phở tái.
entries.outcome: Relaxed over breakfast and talked about the upcoming go-live.

entries.what: Sleeps with the portable unit running on its last day.
entries.outcome: Sleeps better as it cools.

entries.what: Returns the portable unit to Hạnh's Pell Road house as the heat wave breaks and fog rolls back in.
entries.outcome: Heat plan ends.

entries.what: Does laundry using the card-only machines at Marisol Gardens and reloads the card $20.
entries.outcome: Clothes washed and scrubs ready.

entries.what: Sunday dinner at Hạnh's house with Linh, who talks about starting classes.
entries.outcome: Hạnh nudges Linh about pharmacy again, and Thao steers away from it.
